blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — PMFTC Inc., the Philippine affiliate of Philip Morris International (PMI), brought together policy experts, scientists, health experts, and industry leaders on Nov. 10, 2026, for its “Technovation: Smoke-Free by PMFTC” summit at Manila Marriott Hotel in Pasay City. The summit served as a platform for discussions on tobacco harm reduction, product innovation, consumer education, and evidence-based approaches that can support adult smokers who would otherwise smoke in their journey towards smoke-free alternatives. In his welcome remarks, PMFTC President Zhenya Ivanov underscored the importance of bringing PMI’s flagship summit to the Philippines for the first time. READ: PMFTC strengthens collaboration […]...
